Here, the big prizes have outlasted the tickets so far, which is the setup you want to see. All of it comes straight from official Texas lottery numbers, current through September 27.
2769.headline: A progress report

2770.body: Somewhere out there, a $1 million ticket on "Lucky 7 Tripler" got cashed over a week ago. The board launched with four top prizes and now shows three top prizes — that count is the heartbeat of this page, and it just skipped. Everything below the top tier keeps rolling. Every line of Lucky 7 Tripler's prize table below is today's tally, not last month's.
2770.headline: One less $1 million out there

2771.body: The most interesting number on "Lucky 7 Multiplier" is the one that hasn't moved: four of four top prizes still unclaimed, same as it's been since we started watching it, while the rest of the board keeps paying out and shrinking. Fewer tickets in the stack, same big prizes waiting. If you're a regular on this game, bookmark it — this write-up refreshes with every morning's data.
2771.headline: The top prizes keep dodging everybody

2772.body: Fresh off the truck: "Electric 10s", a $2 game from the Texas Lottery with six top prizes of $30,000 on the board. Nothing big has been won yet — almost nobody's played it yet. The moment that changes, the numbers on this page will show it. Same time tomorrow — the board will have moved a little, and this page will move with it.
2772.headline: New kid on the shelf

2773.headline: Factory-fresh and untouched
